claims.text: Two mechanics argue over an engine in a cramped garage.

The garage is a cramped residential space with a concrete floor, clutter, and a bare work lamp; an exposed four-cylinder engine sits on a steel stand between the two men.
Both mechanics wear oil-stained work clothes, and the older man is weathered and calloused while the younger man has a rigid, resistant posture.

description.text: In a cramped residential garage, an exposed four-cylinder engine rests on a steel stand between two mechanics in oil-stained work clothes. The older mechanic straightens from the open bay, drags a rag across his knuckles, and fixes the younger man with a flat look as he delivers a brief verdict. The younger mechanic keeps one palm braced on the valve cover, his weight forward, unwilling to step back. A bare work lamp throws hard highlights across the block and the concrete, while the garage's clutter presses in around them. The older man's verdict shifts the tension onto the younger mechanic.
The older mechanic straightens beside the exposed engine while the younger mechanic braces a palm on the valve cover.
The older mechanic wipes his hands on a rag and fixes the younger man with a flat look.
The older mechanic delivers a brief verdict, jaw barely moving, while the younger man holds his ground.
A rag drags across knuckles; low garage room tone hums beneath.

The younger mechanic lifts a frayed drive belt off the engine and turns it in the light, showing the cracked ribs along its inner face. He answers with a short retort, jaw set, while the older mechanic's shadow falls across the belt and the engine stand. The belt hangs between them as visible evidence, and the younger man does not lower it. Rubber creaks as the belt flexes, and a tool knocks softly against the stand. The disputed belt becomes the visible evidence between them, and the younger mechanic answers back instead of conceding.

The older mechanic leans in over the belt and taps one cracked rib with a calloused finger, holding the younger man's stare. The younger mechanic's grip tightens on the belt without lowering it; neither backs off. The garage falls into a tense silence, with only the faint tick of cooling metal and the sound of breathing through the nose. The cracked belt remains suspended between their opposing positions, the dispute locked in a silent standoff.

A fingernail ticks on hardened rubber; quiet breathing settles into the garage room tone.
